issue_context.title: [migration phase 1] taint and toleration as framework plugins
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:

Implement pod-tolerates-node-taints, both predicate and priority as a plugin in the scheduling framework. This is going to be done by calling into the predicate/priority functions rather than actually moving the code according to phase 1 migration plan.

**Why is this needed**:
phase 1 framework migration

/sig scheduling
/assign

review_comments:
How should we sort the same type of plugin so that` cmp.Diff(tc.wantPlugins, gotPlugins)` does not get an error?
`cmp.Diff` should ignore the order of the elements in the slice, but it is not.
Why do we need to sort? The order is stable, wouldn't for example NodePorts be always before taint toleration?

> The order is stable, wouldn't for example NodePorts be always before taint toleration?

Thank you for your quickly reply. Where can I get this stable order.
But in general, just test it out and see where it lands in the list, it shouldn't change from run to run.

A nit: pluginConfig -> pluginConfigs.

(We have multiple places naming like this, so can be addressed in another PR.)
ok, lets do a cleanup followup PR.
I think it's worth adding a comment saying that this predicate doesn't use the metadata. Same for NormalizeScore below.
A nit: reading -> Error while reading ...

-1
Errorf will already put an E in the log line. `while` is implied.
I agree with Aldo on this one.
